content: S uya iřim d imeḍfaren n AREBBI am iḥenjiren iɛizzen,
uyurem di tayri am mammec uřa d Lmasiḥ tuɣa ittexs aneɣ, iwca ixef nnes xaneɣ d tawhibt d tɣarṣt i AREBBI, aqa-tt d ict n řefwaḥet taṣebḥant.
Maca x farq-ccɣeř d marra řexmej d ṭṭmeɛ, war xas ittiři bu wawař jar awem am mammec icuwwar i imqeddasen,
uřa x řhard issbehdřen niɣ x wawařen ixwan niɣ x tqeṣṣart niɣ x řefḍiḥet, timesřayin i war neffɛent di walu, maca mammec nneɣni ittxeṣṣa aqadi.
Minzi tessnem aqa kuř ijj wenni itteggen farq-ccɣeř, niɣ wenni dayes řexmej niɣ ṭṭmeɛ, aqa wanita iɛebbed l’aṣnam, war ɣares bu tesɣart di tgeldit n Lmasiḥ u n AREBBI.
War ttejjim uřa d ijjen ad kenniw iɣekkwi s wawařen ixwan, aqa zi man aya dd-ihekkwa weɣḍab n AREBBI x tarwa n řmuɛṣiyyet.
War carrcem ca akidsen!
Minzi zic tuɣa kenniw d taǧest, maca aqa řexxu kenniw d tafawt di Siditneɣ. S uyenni uyurem am tarwa n Tfawt,
minzi řɣiǧet n Tfawt tᵉttiři di marra tcuni d tsegda d tidett.
Farzem min ɣa yarḍan Siditneɣ.
War carrcem ca di řexdayem tibarcanin i war dd-ittiwyen řɣiǧet, maca webbxem tent.
Minzi min tteggen di tnuffra, aqa-t d nnɛi i war tzemmared uřa ad t tɛawded.
Minzi marra ad ittwasegged s Tfawt u ad ittwassargeb s Tfawt u marra min issargaben d Tifawt i yeǧa.
S uyenni qqaren:
“Faq cek, a bu yiḍeṣ. Kkar-dd zi taddart n imettinen, uca ad xak igg Lmasiḥ tafawt.”
Ḥḍam ad tuyurem s uweqqar, war iǧi am ibuhařiyyen, maca am imiɣisen,
inni i ɣa yawyen ariqqi i řweqt nsen, minzi ussan-a d iɛeffanen.
X uyenni war ttiřim d ibuhařiyyen, maca fehmem min ixs AREBBI.
War seccaram ca s binu i ittawyen ɣar řeqjaḥet, maca iřim tɛemmarem s Arruḥ.
Siwřem di řeɛmur nwem s izehhiden d izřan n uṣebbeḥ d izřan n Arruḥ, ɣennjem deg wuřawen nwem i SIDI.
Qadam řebda AREBBI Babatneɣ x kuř ijjen deg Yisem n Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Waḍḍɛem ixef nwem i wayawya di tayri n Lmasiḥ.
Řemřac d ṣṣifet n Lmasiḥ d Tmesmunt
A timɣarin, waḍḍɛent i yeryazen nkent am tᵉttwaḍḍɛent i Siditneɣ,
minzi aryaz aqa d azeǧif n temɣart am uřa d Lmasiḥ i yeǧan d Azeǧif n tmesmunt d wenni itticen Tudart i Arrimet.
Am tmesmunt tᵉttwaḍḍeɛ ixef nnes i Lmasiḥ, amenni ɛawed timɣarin ad waḍḍɛent ixef nsent i yeryazen nsent di marra.
A iryazen, xsem timɣarin nwem am mammec tuɣa ixs Lmasiḥ tamesmunt uca isellem Ixef nnes di ṭṭweɛ nnes,
ḥima ad tt yarr d tamqeddast u ad as issizdeg s usird n Waman Iddaren u s Wawař.
Netta ad igg tamesmunt qibač i Yixef nnes s uɛuǧi, břa abeqqiḍ niɣ acebriq, břa uřa d ict n řḥajjet zi marra man aya, maca ad tiři d tamqeddast u břa řɛib.
Ammu ittxeṣṣa ad xsen yeryazen timɣarin nsen am arrimet nsen. Aqa wenni ittexsen tamɣart nnes, aqa ittexs ixef nnes.
Uřa d ijj war icarh ɛemmarṣ arrimet nnes, maca issecca i-t, ittḥawař xas am mammec ittḥawař ɛawed Lmasiḥ x tmesmunt,
minzi neccin d ixfawen n Arrimet nnes, n weysum nnes u n iɣsan nnes.
S uyenni aryaz ad yejj babas d yemmas maḥend ad iqqen ɣar temɣart nnes, ad iřin s tnayen idsen d ijj n weysum.
Ssirr-a d ameqqran, maca necc qqareɣ t zi jjihet n Lmasiḥ d tmesmunt.
Maca ittxeṣṣa ɛawed i kuř ijj zzaywem maḥend ad ixs amenni tamɣart nnes am yixef nnes, maca tamɣart ad tweqqar aryaz.
